name: False Identity
description: Isabel and Diego, two complete strangers, must assume the identity of a married couple in order to flee the state of Sonora.

videos.title: Isabel and Diego's Challenge
videos.overview: The mayor hatches a plan to hide his brother from Gavino's cartel and Isabel from her abusive husband. Gavino puts a price on Diego's head.

videos.title: Isabel and Diego Flee to the United States
videos.overview: Isabel, Diego, and little Ricardo cross into the United States. They are now Camila, Emiliano, and Max Guevara. Eliseo declares war on Gavino.

videos.title: Circe Betrays Her Father
videos.overview: Eliseo learns that Augusto, the Sonora boss, financed his campaign. To prove it, he gives Circe the coordinates for the next shipment of cocaine.

videos.title: Gavino Threatens Circe
videos.overview: After losing the goods to the feds, Gavino discovers who sold him out. Isabel, Ricardo, and Diego arrive in Mexico City. Isabel's daughter disappears.

videos.title: Circe and Joselito Make Love
videos.overview: Thrown out of her house, Circe moves in with Joselito, who says he's the reason she's still alive. Augusto fakes a kidnapping. Isabel can't find work.

videos.title: Isabel Will Do Anything for Her Daughter
videos.overview: Amanda is in danger every second she's with her father. Isabel begins working at a cabaret to be able to pay a good lawyer, and Diego wants to help.

videos.title: Circe Requests Eliseo's Head
videos.overview: Gavino's daughter seeks revenge on Diego, so she seduces Joselito and promises to please him in return for a favor. Piochas and Deivid find Isabel.

videos.title: Diego is Exposed on Television
videos.overview: Emiliano Guevara is interviewed after saving a man's life. Eliseo is annoyed with his brother and resigns from his job to run for governor.

videos.title: Isabel Has a Secret
videos.overview: Isabel lies to Diego about her job again and he plans to expose her. Joselito's thug corners Eliseo. Camila confronts Ramona.

videos.title: Isabel and Diego Kiss
videos.overview: Diego is jealous when Isabel dances for others and demands she quit. Eliseo knows Joselito was with his attacker. Marlene sees Lourdes being taken.

videos.title: Eliseo Suspects Augusto
videos.overview: Zoraida gives Eliseo the gun her stepfather used to kill the prosecutor in return for help saving Amanda. Joselito won't give in to Circe's blackmail.

videos.title: Isabel and Diego Make Love
videos.overview: Isabel tells Diego she's in love with him; they spend the night together. Eliseo faces Augusto. Gavino learns Diego is back; he orders a manhunt.

videos.title: Amanda's Rescue
videos.overview: Amanda's rescue gets tricky. Corona appears to stop Isabel from taking her daughter. Diego confronts him; the three escape. Gavino gets bad news.

videos.title: Circe Leaves Everything for Diego
videos.overview: Circe leaves Joselito at the altar and threatens Eliseo so he will take her to Diego. Isabel won't leave Diego. Corona files a kidnapping report.

videos.title: Circe Kills Diego's Brother
videos.overview: Circe frames Gavino. The feds arrest the Boss. Diego appears at his brother's house and thinks he's kidnapped.

videos.title: Diego Is at a Loss for His Brother
videos.overview: Diego confirms who killed Eliseo and swears revenge. Isabel looks for Diego at the funeral. Joselito orders Circe's murder.

videos.title: An Attack Is Made on Eliseo's Wake
videos.overview: Gavino's men come to the funeral to kill Circe and Diego. Isabel is in love. Joselito finds Circe and ties her up. Gavino is beaten in prison.

videos.title: Isabel and Diego Settle Down
videos.overview: Diego tells Isabel he loves her and wants to start a family. Corona finds out who killed his mother. Joselito orders Deivid's mother killed.

videos.title: Fernanda is Put in the Street
videos.overview: Fernanda is suicidal because of what has happened to her. Joselito wants to make Circe ask for forgiveness. Gavino is eager to get out of prison.

videos.title: Circe arrives at Babel
videos.overview: After the cartel puts a price on their heads, Circe and Felipa go to Mexico City. Corona drops the charges. Diego wants to go to Babel with Isabel.

videos.title: Joselito Orders a Kidnapping
videos.overview: The cartel doesn't have a bead on Circe or Diego and thinks they left together. Joselito orders Fernanda to be kidnapped. Jim makes Isabel an offer.

videos.title: Gavino on the Brink of Death
videos.overview: Gavino is badly hurt in a prison attack. Joselito wants him dead so he can lead the cartel. Fernanda arrives at Diego's house. Jim seeks investors.

videos.title: Circe Creates Her Own Cartel
videos.overview: With Augusto's money and Brandon's aid, Circe will wipe out the Gaonas to form the world's strongest cartel. Isabel learns who Marlene's boyfriend is.

videos.title: Circe's Great Moment
videos.overview: Circe seizes the Gaonas' business. Corona finds his son. Piochas plans to rescue Gavino. Isabel learns what Augusto is doing.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Isabel tells Diego that Porfirio is closing in. Diego will do anything to protect his family. The Colombians make other deals, but Joselito finds out.

videos.title: Diego Rejects Circe
videos.overview: Circe learns Diego is with another woman and swears to have no mercy. Corona comes to Isabel's house. Piochas looks to get Gavino out of the hospital.

videos.title: Circe Meets Camila
videos.overview: The new dancer at Babel catches Circe's eye; she asks to meet her, not knowing she's with Diego. Corona reveals Diego and Fernanda's location.

videos.title: Joselito Lets Diego Live
videos.overview: Diego decides to go because the cartel may return for him. Joselito gets Isabel's photo. Circe successfully moves drugs. Gavino knows he was betrayed.

videos.title: Joselito Recognizes Isabel
videos.overview: Joselito confirms Camila is with Diego and has her take him to the table. Corona and Diego fight over Isabel. Circe agrees to meet the Gaonas.

videos.title: Camila Flirts With Joselito
videos.overview: Joselito continues toying with Camila. She thinks it's under control and he doesn't recognize her. Augusto realizes who killed Eliseo.

videos.title: Circe and Joselito Face to Face
videos.overview: Joselito meets Hot Mama and learns that she is Circe. They threaten each other's lives over the drug trade. The dancers are at risk.

videos.title: Danger finds Isabel in Babel
videos.overview: Joselito goes crazy when he finds out that the waitresses escaped. Diego learns the truth about Babel. The warden orders Gavino back to his cell.

videos.title: Diego Distances Himself From Isabel
videos.overview: Isabel asks for Diego's forgiveness. Upset, he asks for space to decide if they should stay together. Circe visits Gavino in prison; he attacks her.

videos.title: Circe Wants to Recruit Diego
videos.overview: Hot Mama has one day to move the goods and wants Diego as a guide. Joselito can give her the location. Diego contacts the real Emiliano's aunt.

videos.title: Circe Arrives at Diego's House
videos.overview: With the information Joselito gives her, Circe figures out who robbed her man. Joselito visits Gavino in prison. Corona's condition worsens.

videos.title: Isabel and Diego Reconcile
videos.overview: After Circe's visit, Diego tells Isabel the truth about his past. They promise to start over. Marlene begins to suspect Augusto.

videos.title: Circe Receives a Threat
videos.overview: The Colombians want to see their goods arrive. If Circe can't hold up her end, they'll get back at her and Diego. The Gaonas have Brandon and Augusto.

videos.title: The Plot Set Against Joselito
videos.overview: Joselito intercepts the truckload of drugs. Fernanda finds out who her husband's lover is. Isabel wants to help her children's father.

videos.title: Joselito Sends a Message
videos.overview: Joselito seeks revenge on Diego. Hot Mama seduces Diego. Corona goes to the hospital. Joselito interrogates Augusto and orders Felipa kidnapped.

videos.title: Circe Receives a Big Hit
videos.overview: The Gaonas have Felipa. Circe and the girls arrive at Babel to rescue her. Diego accepts the Colombians' offer. Fernanda confronts Augusto.

videos.title: Isabel Quits the Farce
videos.overview: To protect her kids, Isabel decides to leave her fake marriage. Circe has half the country after Joselito: she offers a million dollars for his head.

videos.title: Luck Is on Circe's Side
videos.overview: Circe learns that Diego is a free man and seeks to win back the love of her life. Gavino starts doing business in jail. Deivid advises Chucho.

videos.title: Isabel's Children Are Taken
videos.overview: Joselito can't stand Diego working with Circe and sends his men out to get him. Corona wants to get back his family and his wife's love.

videos.title: The Plan to Kill Joselito
videos.overview: Piochas and Mateo prepare an ambush to get rid of Joselito and obtain the reward. Isabel doesn't want to see Diego again. Circe casts a love spell.

videos.title: Corona, Closer to Death
videos.overview: Corona's health deteriorates. Isabel is ready to do anything to save her children's father. Diego and Circe take territory from Joselito.

videos.title: Joselito Goes After Circe
videos.overview: The Gaonas attack Hot Mama's warehouse, and Joselito does everything he can to get her. Circe tries to escape but is shot. Fernanda divorces Augusto.

videos.title: The Passion of Diego
videos.overview: Diego rescues Circe and takes her to his house to heal her wounds. Hot Mama reminds him that he's hers. Isabel decides to give herself a chance.

videos.title: Isabel With the Broken Heart
videos.overview: After the real Emiliano's aunt visits, Isabel looks for Diego. When she finds him, she gets the surprise of her life. Circe frames Augusto.

videos.title: Circe Makes a Move
videos.overview: Hot Mama wants to multitask: if Joselito and Augusto will come to her, she can kill them both. Marlene can't believe her fiance is a killer.

videos.title: Circe's Sweet Revenge
videos.overview: Circe enjoys seeing Joselito and Augusto tied up and decides to take what's owed her. Mateo wants to start a new business. Marlene confronts Diego.

videos.title: Paloma Confronts Camila
videos.overview: Isabel's need is growing. She is looking for work and tells Paloma one of her biggest secrets. Diego feels betrayed by his loved ones.

videos.title: Circe and Diego Are in for a Surprise
videos.overview: Desperate to see his stepfather, Diego gets Circe to take him to where Joselito and Augusto are; something unexpected happens. Gavino has a plan.

videos.title: Joselito's Other Face
videos.overview: Joselito has to change plans and find help to regain power. Circe, Diego, and the Colombians know where he is and corner him.

videos.title: Diego Sleeps With the Enemy
videos.overview: Diego goes to the hospital to get rid of Augusto. Circe wants to kill the man she loves before he learns the truth. Marlene makes a wedding decision.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Things get even worse for Isabel; Margot Guevara threatens to put her in prison. Circe has a hard time seeing Diego at his brother's grave.

videos.title: Diego's New Plan
videos.overview: Circe must decide if she wants to do the same as Diego. He wants to make a change in his life. Isabel looks for Diego. Margot wants more evidence.

videos.title: Diego Ready to Face the Music
videos.overview: Isabel can't leave the city. Diego wants to talk to Margot to tell her the truth. Augusto agrees to testify on Gavino's behalf.

videos.title: A Ticking Time Bomb for Isabel and Diego
videos.overview: Margot is about to find proof of Isabel and Diego's charade. Circe makes them look for Emiliano's aunt. Isabel gets an opportunity to flee.

videos.title: Circe Stains Her Hands With Blood for Diego
videos.overview: To separate Diego and Isabel, Circe finds Emiliano's aunt to threaten her, but she loses control. Marlene confronts Augusto; Mateo blackmails Isabel.

videos.title: Circe Exposes Herself
videos.overview: Diego knows that Circe is involved with the Guevaras' aunt's death. She learns Margot thwarted her plans to leave with him. Isabel wants the truth.

videos.title: Augusto Publicly Accuses Joselito
videos.overview: Augusto attests to Gavino's innocence and says Joselito is the real cartel boss. Isabel feels like she's to blame. Circe and Diego plan to leave.

videos.title: Circe and Diego Must Pay a High Price
videos.overview: Hot Mama's dream of leaving with Diego is interrupted when they get an ultimatum they must comply with. Diana and Gaby get into trouble.

videos.title: Circe's World Collapses
videos.overview: Hot Mama visits her father in prison. She confronts him and the Boss fires back, telling her Felipa's deepest secret. Gaby may be deported.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Circe is furious with Felipa and wants to kill her. Diego shares his plan with Deivid. Corona and Mateo get out of surgery. Augusto attacks Marlene.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Hot Mama plans to get out of the business, but Gavino is ready to bring her down. She doesn't know what she's up against. Diego plans his last move.

videos.title: All in Gavino Gaona's Favor
videos.overview: At Gavino's trial, Augusto testifies on his behalf; Eliseo's memory becomes tainted. Isabel learns that Diego and Circe are leaving the country.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: The Boss makes his move and achieves his goals. He begins to take revenge by killing all his enemies and capturing Circe. Diego looks for Gavino.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Circe begins to feel her father's wrath. The Boss does his best to leave her without allies or a way out; he talks to Ramona to learn her escape plan.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: The Boss and Diego are even. Each one has in his power someone important to the other and is sure that the other will do everything to find her.

videos.title: Diego Is Speechless
videos.overview: After getting some of his enemies together, Gavino proposes a truce to Diego. Circe tries to save her business. Joselito decides to return to Mexico.

videos.title: Circe's Right-Hand Man
videos.overview: Desperate, Hot Mama thinks Diego can save her, not knowing that he's waiting for the moment to attack. Marlene talks about her feelings for Jim.

videos.title: Circe and Diego Look Each Other in the Eye
videos.overview: Gavino sows discord between Circe and Diego. Augusto tries to take advantage of Marlene's sister. Gaby wants to go to the U.S., far from Deivid.

videos.title: Diego's Proposal
videos.overview: After buttering up Circe, Diego makes an offer. She says they will get the goods back soon. The Colombians are uneasy about Joselito's return.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Thinking she knows what Diego is up to, Circe calls him, but he decides not to talk to her. Porfirio learns that the feds are looking for his father.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Isabel goes to Alamos with Diego, but is followed by security cameras there. Circe confronts her father.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Gavino swears Circe is out of the business; he visits the Colombians to get more power, but all is not as it seems. Isabel and Diego work as a team.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Although Diego wants to keep Isabel out of his plans, she won't leave his side. Gavino wants Circe out of the drug trade. Joselito is about to attack.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Joselito plans to take out Gavino at Babel. When he's about to kill the Boss, something happens to change his plans. Porfirio and Paloma are together.

videos.title: Diego in Circe's Claws
videos.overview: Circe still thinks she has control of Diego, but she misses something. The feds get Joselito; Gavino wants his head. Mateo wants to show his loyalty.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: As the feds are moving Joselito, they are caught in an ambush. Mateo shows he is loyal to Gavino. Diego is close to his goal, but Circe is suspicious.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Gavino wants to settle scores with Joselito. Nuria endures a traumatic episode. Circe begins to investigate Diego. Jim sets fire to Babel.

videos.title: Circe Receives a Grim Present
videos.overview: Gavino finds Circe and leaves her a chilling message. Diego asks for immunity for Isabel and himself. Porfirio threatens to take Isabel's children.

videos.title: Diego Exposed
videos.overview: Diego plans to capture Circe, who faces her worst nightmare. Agent Williams finds Isabel's house. Gavino wants to ally with Alex Mendez.

videos.title: Circe's Sinister Plan
videos.overview: Diego wants to avenge his brother's death, but Hot Mama has a different plan. Williams has the proof he needs to arrest Isabel and Diego.

videos.title: Diego Declares War on Circe
videos.overview: After an attempt at capture fails, Diego and Circe come clean. Gavino's ruse is exposed. Isabel agrees to be separated from her children.

videos.title: Diego's Difficult Decision
videos.overview: There's only one way for Diego to protect Isabel and the children. Fernanda's restaurant is attacked. Circe has a new ally. Amanda disappears.

videos.title: Diego in the Wolf's Mouth
videos.overview: After Gavino's attack, Diego decides to take justice into his own hands. Mateo goes behind Gavino's back. Isabel threatens her father-in-law.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Isabel's worst nightmare becomes reality and there's no way out. Marlene finds Jim. Circe accepts Mateo's offer. Nuria confesses to her addiction.

videos.title: Circe Corners Gavino
videos.overview: The leader of the Gaonas falls into Mateo's trap. Circe seeks revenge. Isabel and Diego receive an offer. Salas turns himself in to the authorities.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: The war between father and daughter ends. Isabel is on the verge of death; Diego and Porfirio work together to save her. Salas says he's to blame.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Isabel and Diego are ready to be a family, but an enemy is lurking. Circe tries to escape. Paloma loses a loved one. Fernanda says goodbye to Salas.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Diego and Isabel are in a witness protection program, but he breaks the rules to get in touch with his mother Fernanda. Ignacio Salas remains free.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Circe faces murder, drug trafficking and money laundering charges. Rogelio receives a cry for help. The Sonora prosecutor intervenes, with conditions.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Amanda goes to meet her grandfather. Isabel's love for her daughter is so great that it pushes her to make a drastic decision to get her family back.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The die is cast. Now that hatred is Circe's driving force, heads will roll. Mami Chula and El Buitre join forces for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Badly wounded, Diego takes refuge in a church to flee Mateo's men, who are armed to the teeth. Victoria and Father Rafael must make a decision.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Diego and Isabel are so close, yet so far. Victoria and Father Rafael begin the escape plan, but El Pollo is suspicious. Fernanda confronts Mateo.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Amanda tells her grandfather how she and her brother suffered at the hands of Circe and Alex. Ramona must pick a side: her lover's or her niece's?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Circe and El Buitre are together and everyone is talking. Mateo goes to look for them. A tense situation may cost the Arismendi family dearly.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Diego, Deivid and Chucho follow Circe's trail to the cemetery. Mami Chula thinks she sees Joselito among the tombstones. Diana goes to the police.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Rosa just wants to flee, but Circe insists on going after Diego to finish him. Diana ends up in the hospital. Chucho suffers a painful interrogation.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Isabel takes a risk, says goodbye to Ricas, and meets The Man. She puts her plan into action once at the hotel... not thinking of the consequences.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Mateo finds Circe's hideout and goes after her. El Buitre and his father become unwilling accomplices. Mami Chula hears when Claudio challenges Mateo.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Isabel will try to rescue her daughter and Fernanda, but she'll need more than luck and accomplices to evade security at the hacienda.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Isabel is forced to tell Mateo where his grandson is. Meanwhile, Ramona advises Mateo to let others do the dirty work. Amanda misses her family.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Circe knows how to attract men...and El Buitre is no exception. Claudio shows what he's made of, though he doesn't know he's missing something.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Circe receives key information to kill Diego. Mami Chula uses the same frequency as Mateo's truck. Lupe and Alberto play an important role.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: In the desert, Mateo's victims are dehydrated and running out of air. A hole in the truck becomes a coveted prize. Salas gives Diego some information.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Diego and Victoria search for Isabel, who's nowhere to be found. Only one place remains to look: the morgue. Mauricio orders Chávez to arrest Hidalgo.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: El Buitre makes Victoria an offer to get her to hand Diego over. She and Inés are a thorn in Mateo's side. Circe goes after Ricas to find Hidalgo.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Circe detains Diego and finds his weak spot: his family. Taking advantage of this, she leaves him in an abandoned warehouse, with a gun and a choice.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Nana, Circe, Apá and El Buitre make an unplanned pact. Mami Chula's reputation as a dangerous traitor is indisputable. Ricas and Diego mourn a loss.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: El Buitre's suspicions are confirmed and Diego is involved. A confession unleashes a beating and Circe is exposed. Hidalgo has important information.

videos.title: Episodio  23
videos.overview: Mateo's leadership is at risk, so Mauricio launches a campaign against the huachicoleros and their leader. Enraged, El Buitre responds in cold blood.

videos.title: Episodio 24
videos.overview: Mateo isn't sure how much Isabel knew about Diego. Amanda asks questions. Her grandfather vows to bring Ricas in and keep the enemy from sinking him.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Mateo tries to make the most of his final goodbye to Isabel. Amanda vows to find the person responsible for her mother's death.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Victoria tells Diego he is putting custody of Ricas at risk. Diego is ready to find crucial evidence. A wedding abroad proves convenient for Mateo.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Amanda is unafraid and determined to go after her grandfather's enemy. Everyone is looking for Ricas and believes that Corona took him by force.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Diego and Mateo come before the judge to air their grievances. Victoria tries to control her client. Mateo shines as the concerned grandfather.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Diego and his followers must train and procure weapons. Victoria leads Hidalgo to an impressive hidden arsenal. Joselito plays dirty with Circe.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Mateo tries to bribe Judge Sequeira to win custody of his grandchildren; the scales begin to tip in his favor. Father Rafael takes Lamas from school.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Jaimito and Ignacio risk everything and go to Mateo's hacienda. Patricia and Rubén are ready to take Fernanda to the hospital, but things go awry.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Salas challenges Mateo and warns him that someday he will pay for everything. Corona thinks about Fernanda. Rubén winds up as an unwilling accomplice.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Victoria sees Diego as the man who pushes her to fight for her ideals. Someone who gives people hope. She has never met anyone like him before.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Victoria recognizes Jaimito in one of Joselito's publications. Now that they know about the plan to rescue Fernanda, maybe they could find Salas.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Amanda sees Benito, and Mateo takes matters into his own hands. A lie comes to light, and suspicion of a betrayal brings serious consequences.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Mateo now sees how to end the war with the Arismendi family: by trading Circe for El Cachorro. Claudio vows to turn Mateo's hacienda into a graveyard.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Mateo loses control. Lupe becomes nervous and Victoria offers to take Alberto far away, but he thinks of the consequences. Everyone is under threat.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: After Salas's statement, Diego organizes a rescue. Victoria tells him to bring Lupe and Alberto. El Buitre learns of the plan involving El Cachorro.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: If Fernanda talks, Mateo will go to jail. Chávez is ordered to find her as soon as possible. Even if Rafael wanted to help, it would be very risky.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Diego does not believe the police, but he knows that Victoria trusts Bracho, so together they devise a plan that could cost them dearly.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Victoria is worried, so Diego calls Mateo and makes a promise. Bracho starts to build the case and thinks of a trustworthy prosecutor.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Fernanda is ready to see Salas, with the help of Father Rafael and a strategy that seeks to mislead everyone. Chávez takes statements at the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Diego and Ricas want to see Amanda and file an injunction against Mateo. Corona bans her from seeing her stepfather and brother. No one will concede.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Mateo discovers Diego's self-defense group and attacks, convinced that striking first gives him an advantage. Frida is the bait for Hidalgo's gang.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Victoria gathers enough information to blackmail The Man and gets the coordinates to bring back Nuria and Frida. Diego tries to intervene.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: The judge has made a decision on custody of the Corona siblings. Victoria, Diego and Fuentes await a verdict that will mark a before and after.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Diego convinces Ricas there's only one way to stop Mateo from taking him. As Victoria says goodbye, she receives an unexpected message from Alberto.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Several things surprise Ricas on arriving at Mateo's hacienda. Amanda sheds tears of regret, makes a call from the heart, and fearfully asks for help.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Mateo's men surprise Diego and Apá. War with the Arismendi family looms; Corona already has a strategy. Victoria enlists a doctor as an accomplice.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Victoria cannot believe that Diego would consider allying with El Apá. During a heated argument, she gives him a warning. Then everything changes.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Mateo threatens Father Rafael, asking Mauricio to expel him from the country since he is a hindrance. The search for Salas and Bracho intensifies.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: In a desperate attempt to reach the hideout where Bracho took Salas, Diego and Deivid confront a patrol car and become involved in a shootout.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Tired of being in hiding, Fernanda ignores Diego's advice and goes to the hospital to see Salas. Mateo finds out and sets a life or death ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Chucho and Diego have a man-to-man discussion. Hidalgo realizes that money can undermine loyalty. Fernanda is very worried.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Diego goes to "turn himself in" to El Buitre while Circe attends to business matters with Nana and Jaimito, unaware that someone is stalking them.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Diego confirms to Deivid that he is allied with El Buitre, but doesn't tell Victoria. He knows joining the Arismendis could ruin their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Now, El Apá's life is worth three, as the exchange includes Circe, Diego, and the counterfeiter Jaimito. Mateo's enemies devise a rescue plan.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Both sides will give their all on a decisive night. Victoria puts into action a bold new strategy to attack Mateo's criminal network from the inside.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Fernanda manipulates the situation to protect Diego and he is completely bewildered. Hidalgo looks for Victoria, but doesn't find her.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Humberto gives Jaime a photo of Valentina Acosta, a supposed friend of Victoria's, so that he can falsify her identity. Diego is suspicious.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: The Man must make good on the deal and help Victoria. Mateo will oversee that group of immigrants, so there's more risk, but she goes through with it.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: The Man does his job and Victoria is left alone, not knowing what will become of her. Diego confesses to Father Rafael, who tells him about Victoria.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Chávez launches an operation and El Buitre abandons a funeral in full swing. A chase ensues and Circe tries to vanish into the cemetery.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Now that Victoria is on the inside of organized crime, The Man drugs her to entrap her in prostitution. Diego confronts Humberto about Lamas.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: The police go to the bar where Mateo runs his business. Victoria could testify, but she can't talk. El Míster bribes the authorities to drop the case.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Diego hears a name and takes the risk of looking for information about Victoria. Meanwhile, Mateo strives to find out who she is and what she wants.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Victoria confronts her kidnapper, warning him not to kill her. Seeking evidence against Mateo, she confides in Nuria, who tells El Míster the truth.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Hearing gunshots on a call, Diego urges Humberto to tell him where Victoria is. Disguised as Valentina, the lawyer discovers hell in the maquilas.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: On Victoria's trail, Diego and Deivid arrive at a bar. No one recognizes her, but one of the girls mentions that there's a brave lawyer among them.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Mateo proposes a pact and summons El Buitre alone, in secret, and unarmed. Diego senses something is off. Victoria recognizes him and tells Nuria.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Victoria's mission becomes more difficult when she suspects that Diego is part of the plan. She takes measures after talking to her accomplice.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Help capturing Mateo isn't enough. Handing him over to the authorities is no guarantee he'll be locked up for life, so Diego proposes an alternative.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Fixated on her goal, Victoria informs the authorities she's no longer alone. Diego vows to rescue her, sending her a message through Nuria.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: El Míster fears for the safety of his children, so Victoria offers him a way to protect them. A secret meeting exceeds the limits of the mission.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Fernanda implements her plan and distracts Mateo with her charms. Alberto, Ricas and Amanda escape, but the border crossing is too busy.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: A risky escape attempt puts Fernanda in danger. Victoria and Nuria rely on The Man to steal more evidence that compromises Mateo.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: On Mateo's orders, Darwin threatens Victoria and El Míster at gunpoint. Diego, the federal agent, and team go after them. Ramona makes an accusation.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: A dossier with ironclad evidence doesn't seem to be enough to arrest Corona. A biased judge and government involvement lead Diego to confront Mateo.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Circe learns that Vidal is in jail and decides to take his money; going after Ramona, she has an unexpected reunion. El Buitre gets even with Jaimito.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Victoria believes they only have what Chucho was able to get out of Vidal in prison, but there is overwhelming evidence.
